name: target-energy-bandwidth-2x2
required_before_training: Immutable code commit and this protocol SHA256
Exact train/validation manifests, raw label export SHA256 and per-record effective bandwidth
Complete prior exposure inventory and fresh16k LibriSpeech/RixVox acceptance metadata
Fullband SLR83 reservation SHA256; licensed-source notices and conservative user grouping
Source transforms, tools/native receipts and strict role/speaker separation audit; no acceptance waveforms or quality opened

model.last_power: actual last received post-Phase1 MDCT before normalized history clipping; original native f32 band reduction
model.inference: Network once, actual student phase read, MDCT once, measure candidate power, derive bounded gains, existing inverse/OLA
model.fallback: explicit gains1 and phase0; d0 is NOT identity; no interpretation of installed gain weights as d

teacher.phase: unchanged PhaseWide grid/correlation below4kHz and tie order in neural-plc-phase-protocol.json
teacher.history: classical candidate0 only; teacher choices never synthesized into causal inputs
export: source/effective bandwidth and physical band mask
role,source,speaker group,utterance and native source hashes
teacher.target: uninterrupted decoded Phase1 MDCT; never infer raw powers from previously clamped gains
teacher.training_denominator: teacher-phase candidate, fixed offline; not falsely identified with student-phase candidate
teacher.phase_proxy: A future-informed teacher-phase denominator is a deliberate supervised proxy. Native inference measures its own phase. Full phase-off/on reports are mandatory; this is not end-to-end exact phase-conditioned training.

objective.supervision: smoothL1(z, clamp(.5*(L_target-L_pred_teacher),lo,hi), beta=.05); DO NOT clamp student z before this term
objective.reduction: supported-band mean PER FRAME, then equal EN/SV frame/language weight
objective.saturation: raw teacher d extremes outside the controllable interval have identical target and loss; wrong-side student saturation retains a supervised gradient
objective.change_from_PR31: Matched new gain-ratio control uses the same clipped-target Huber and action anchor, replacing previous squared-log-gain loss. This2x2 tests representations/bandwidth under one new objective; it does not isolate loss change versus PR31.

training.initialization: same seeded hidden layers; zero final rows; no output d penalty; AdamW parameter decay is separate
training.checkpoint: final step1920 only; no epoch/seed search or retry based on validation
training.corpus: same344 train/validation VCTK/RixVox raw clips as PR31, manifest45923ded50be1de353323210977eedc8c935752c8b796f54fd22af8274664ac6;320 training clips,24 validation clips
training.augmentation: same fixed bitrate12/24/32,duration10/20,harmonic0/1,noise/gain tuple per utterance across both data factors; only source bandwidth changes
training.bandwidth: native: EN48k/SV16k. balanced: per EN training speaker hash8 utterances and lowpass/downsample first4 to16k, then resample codec input48k before fixed noise/gain; SV unchanged
training.source_transform: aresample=16000:resampler=soxr:precision=28,aresample=48000:resampler=soxr:precision=28; pin FFmpeg binary/version and every output PCM hash before fitting; no loudness/quality based choices
training.mask: complete bands end<=effective Nyquist;16k supports native bands0..12,48k supports0..15; source/effective bandwidth per record, never infer mask from language

validation.source: same known development speakers; every EN validation clip evaluated at both bandwidths
validation.applications: four fits x phase forced0/phase enabled =8 frozen candidates; identical fitted weights within each pair; retain all17 rows
validation.strata: each cell/bitrate/duration/mode ESTOI delta>=-.001 against each reference; report all noise/pattern slices too; finite complete factor matrix mandatory
ranking: maximize minimum cell ESTOI delta versus PR31
minimize summed cell envelope ratios versus PR31
minimize summed cell MR-STFT ratios versus PR31
fixed candidate order ratio_native_off,ratio_native_on,energy_native_off,energy_native_on,ratio_balanced_off,ratio_balanced_on,energy_balanced_off,energy_balanced_on on exact ties
validation.no_admission: retain PR31; no candidate enters acceptance

acceptance.fullband: 24 fixed utterances,12 conservative user groups; source CC-BY-SA4; no SLR83 audio used for fitting/validation; verify48k mono headers after selection, no replacement after unblinding
acceptance.en16k_selection: new12 published IDs absent all documented LibriSpeech exposures; hash speaker then clip25..50words using salt snacka-target-energy-20261023:
acceptance.sv16k_selection: new12 canonical riksdagen_id, canonical speaker_id equality, year>=2015,lang_prob_sv>=.99,not silence,duration>=12000ms; hash speaker then row; one middle12s clip; exclude prior50 RixVox identities
acceptance.controls: exact same PR31 and classical frozen source/probes; packets/uninterrupted PCM checked; source and selected weights/executables sealed before staging test waveforms
acceptance.guards: all per-cell/stratum validation rules; additionally speaker/group paired bootstrap2000replicates,seed20261023,95% ESTOI interval versus classical has lower bound>0 in every cell; report paired intervals versus PR31 but do not call point nonregression proven population noninferiority
acceptance.selection: one candidate only; no fallback, gain/head swap, new epoch, retune or cohort substitution after test
acceptance.speaker_claim: published corpus IDs/conservative groups; no cross-corpus biometric nonoverlap claim

native_gates.parity: native/PyTorch gains<=5e-6 on finite fixtures; current packet/uninterrupted trace exact; complete candidate decoded replay before independent unblinding
native_gates.memory: zero steady-state allocations, logical weights<65536bytes, Decoder<=16352bytes with cache only, Encoder unchanged
native_gates.cpu: M5 integrated candidate/control interleaved timing on known speech; per duration/mode/bitrate first-loss median<=25us; report all operations and tails, no worst-case guarantee
native_gates.compatibility: native packet format unchanged; src/opus and Phase1 untouched; no external runtime dependencies

reporting: source-band masks, teacher saturation fractions and d/loggain distributions by source/bitrate/loss horizon
phase RMSE vszero and phase-off/on deltas
complete raw metrics and per-cell/group-bootstrap intervals
account balance before/after and owned sessions stopped
activation: retain PR31 unless all new independent and native gates pass; cache-only experiments are not a production model adoption
binding_policy: Method immutable; training_allowed remainsfalse in this core. A separate immutable data binding must reference the exact core SHA, source commit and all listed manifests before any fit. Missing binding is not permission to launch training.
